d: Monitor the Bank’s compliance with SAMA regulations, applicable laws, and internal policies and procedures.
Follow up on regulatory correspondence, circulars, and instructions, ensuring timely implementation and escalation of any delays or non-compliance.
Coordinate with relevant departments to prepare and submit accurate regulatory reports, disclosures, and responses within the required deadlines.
Maintain and update the Regulatory Obligations Register and monitor the implementation of regulatory requirements.
Conduct periodic compliance reviews, assess regulatory controls, identify compliance gaps, and follow up on corrective actions.
Review internal policies, procedures, and new or amended banking products and services to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.
Support the implementation of the compliance program, maintain the Compliance Risk Register, and participate in compliance risk assessments.
Provide regulatory compliance guidance and support compliance awareness and training activities across the Bank.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Banking, Finance, or a related field.
Minimum 4 years of banking experience, including at least 3 years in Compliance.
Good knowledge of Saudi Central Bank (SAMA) regulations, banking laws, and applicable regulatory requirements.
Professional certifications in Compliance are preferred.
Good command of Arabic and English, both written and spoken.
Strong analytical, communication, and reporting skills.
Good organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to work effectively within a team.
Ability to maintain confidentiality, manage multiple priorities, and work under pressure.
